{{Top|leg}}
A '''domodroid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. [[Scarlet Bloodhawk]] owned a domodroid, [[H2-1B4]], circa [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. She had owned H2-1B4 for some time, and the droid showed loyalty to their rightful master even in adversity.<ref name="TRG1-119">{{WEGCite|story=Class Reunion|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
